notablePrerequisites:
You control another nontoken colored legendary creature.
You have a colored legendary creature card in hand.
easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that has power 5 or greater.
description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{W}{U}.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping another nontoken colored legendary creature you control, untapping Selvala.
Cast a legendary creature from your hand for its web-slinging cost by paying {G}{W}{U} and returning the creature tapped in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
